mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COM_INTRO_EMAIL ( INQUIRY_COMPANY_NAME, INQUIRY_APPLICANT_NAME, INQUIRY_EMAIL, INQUIRY_CONTACT, INQUIRY_TYPE, INQUIRY_CONTENT, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{companyName}, #{applicantName}, #{email}, #{contact}, #{inquiryType}, #{content}, 'PENDING', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, INQUIRY_COMPANY_NAME AS companyName, INQUIRY_APPLICANT_NAME AS applicantName, INQUIRY_EMAIL AS email, INQUIRY_CONTACT AS contact, INQUIRY_TYPE AS inquiryType, INQUIRY_CONTENT AS content, IFNULL(STATUS, 'PENDING') AS status, ANSWER AS answer, ANSWERED_AT AS answeredAt, ANSWERED_BY AS answeredBy, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM COM_INTRO_EMAIL WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COM_INTRO_EMAIL SET ANSWER = #{answer}, ANSWERED_AT = NOW(), ANSWERED_BY = #{answeredBy}, STATUS = 'ANSWERED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
UPDATE COM_INTRO_EMAIL SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
